Eli’s medium-deep skin, compact square face, asymmetric brows, broad cheek planes, long straight nose, narrow upper lip, cheek mole, copper-auburn gathered curl halo, lilac-smoke draped robe, high soft collar, uneven repaired hems, faded palette variation, and polished seed case are legible. However, the figure reads broad-shouldered and athletic with a tapered, tightly belted waist rather than unmistakably soft-round with an evident middle and gentle limb contours, and a small undeclared hoop earring is visible despite the exact no-accessory manifest.
His direct gaze and closed narrow mouth are calm, neutral, restrained, and unsmiling without theatrical acting.

The distressed cloth robe, plain trousers and shoes, repairs, and quiet seed case remain ordinary mortal details; no weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, logo, watermark, or text appears.
